name: Tokyo Electron Limited
blurb: Tokyo Electron Limited develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor production equipment globally. It offers coaters/developers, plasma etch systems, cleaning systems, deposition systems, test systems, and other products. The company is a leading player in the semiconductor equipment industry, serving markets in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, China, North America, and Europe.
recent: In the past 30 days, Tokyo Electron's stock surged over 8% to a new 52-week high of 51,960 JPY, driven by a broader Japanese tech rally and positive sentiment in the semiconductor sector. The company reported strong earnings on April 30, 2026, with net income up 5.6% year-over-year. The stock has gained over 140% in the past year.
